title_suffix: rectangular boundary batching and radix-distributed sparse-union schedule on PR1673's capped phase-cell fusion outer, pivot-566+554 T74 supplier
summary: Capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673, Vlado Vojdanovski) on this repository's T74 supplier (pivot-566 and pivot-554 helper-donor kernels, certified complex endpoint 0.00167975495612554452133567...), free strict slacks at 1e-64 or below, b = certified endpoint - 1e-64, with two NEW constructions (not in PR1673 or PR1699): a radix-distributed sparse-union schedule (outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md) and rectangular boundary batching with W^2 right-hand-side columns per factor page (outer/RECT-BOUNDARY.md), using the published omega(1,1,2) < 3.250035 of Alman, Duan, Vassilevska Williams, Xu, Xu, Zhou (arXiv 2404.16349) at tau_eff = omega(1,1,2) - 1 = 2.2500351 (fixed format exponent sigma = 3.2500351 strictly above the bound). The 53 strict inequalities, 9 rejecting controls (including reinstating the old union row and sigma at or below the published bound, which fail) and the endpoint rejection are regenerated with an independent balance derivation; two executable schedule simulations are run; the supplier's full native admission is rerun. Conditional, with all inherited all-size hypotheses; the new constructions need independent review; the exponent is a cited theorem.
credits: PR1673 (Vlado Vojdanovski, with AI assistance): capped phase-cell fusion outer construction, its proof and exact evidence, vendored verbatim under vendor/pr1673. Josh Alman, Ran Duan, Virginia Vassilevska Williams, Yinzhan Xu, Zixuan Xu, Renfei Zhou (More Asymmetry Yields Faster Matrix Multiplication, arXiv 2404.16349: omega(1,1,2) < 3.250035). Chafik Boukhalfa (PR1699: specialisation of PR1673's matrix boundary to an established exponent) and Francois Le Gall (omega<2.3728639, ISSAC 2014). The radix-distributed sparse-union schedule is new in this package; its independent review simulation outer/sched_review.py is by LeverRank. Supplier: PR1625 (mdumitrean) pivot-566 helper-donor kernel; PR1661 (midhatn) 400-digit endpoint-grid refinement of that stack; pivot-554 kernel (kernel566.py search by LeverRank/jeremykothe2 tooling, PR1672); PR1297, PR1319, PR1424, PR1485, PR1574 (Rohan Arun) T74 exact fill and cold kernels; PR1274, PR1479, PR1510, PR1513, PR1536, PR1578 (Jeremy Kothe) endpoint and outer-witness lineage; PR1534, PR1549 (midhatn); PR1519 (philippeVV) fine-Mercator soundness repair; PR1286, PR1193 (Jeremy Diviney), PR1148 (Thomas DiFiore) and the retained supplier lineage. Research direction, prioritisation and release strategy: jeremykothe2. Implementation assistance: oh-my-pi.
